localeCode.description: Name of this locale folder, read by the extension to load the whole file. Do not translate.

extDescription.message: Markdown reader for working docs: sort, filter and resize tables, check off tasks saved to the file, outline, Mermaid and math.

cmdCycleTheme.message: Cycle theme (auto → light → dark, all tabs)

codeWrapTitle.message: Toggle line wrapping for this block

toolThemeTitle.message: Theme for all tabs (d cycles: auto → light → dark)

rawLineTitle.message: Click a line number to copy its location

toolCopyMdTitle.message: Copy the whole document's content, or its file location

locationUnknown.message: Can't map the selection to lines in the source

toolExportTitle.message: Download what you see as an HTML file (no scripts). Choose a single file with images embedded, or keep links to the images

toolPrintTitle.message: Print, or choose Save as PDF in the print dialog. Folded sections are expanded and colors switch to light for paper

exportMissed.message: Exported $1. Images not embedded: $2. They keep their original addresses

exportNeedsWebAccess.message: . If an image from a website opens in the browser, turn on "$1" in the Markloupe popup and try again

taskTitle.message: Click to check / uncheck and save to the file

taskNoRoot.message: This file's folder is not authorized for saving yet

taskPermission.message: Access to “$1” needs to be confirmed again

taskConflict.message: The file was changed elsewhere and has been reloaded. Click again.

taskReadonlyRemote.message: Only tasks in local files can be saved

taskReadonlyNetwork.message: Tasks in files on WSL or network paths can't be saved

taskReadonlyOff.message: Saving checkboxes is turned off — turn it on in the popup

taskAmbiguous.message: Several authorized folders contain this file, so Markloupe can't tell which one to save. Remove the extra folder

taskNotUtf8.message: This file is not UTF-8 and cannot be saved

tableCopyTitle.message: Copy as TSV (paste into Excel), using the current sort and filter

mermaidFullscreenTitle.message: Fullscreen: scroll to zoom, drag to move, double-click to reset (Esc to exit)

tableResetTitle.message: Reset column widths, sort and filter

tableResizeTitle.message: Drag to resize, double-click to auto-fit

filesNetwork.message: Folder lists, auto-reload and saving checked tasks don't work for files on WSL or network paths: Chrome doesn't let extensions read these paths.

fileIgnoreTitle.message: Comma-separated; * matches anything, .* hides names starting with a dot

popupEnableTitle.message: When off, pages show as plain text

popupFileWarning.message: Local files are not allowed yet. In the extension's details, turn on Allow access to file URLs.

optLinkNewTab.message: Open external links in a new tab

secEditorNote.message: the toolbar Edit button opens the file

editorHint.message: Only editors that register a URL scheme can be opened from the browser. Notepad and Notepad++ don't, so they can't be supported.

editorInvalid.message: The editor URL must start with the editor's own scheme (such as vscode://) and contain {path}

toolEditTitle.message: Open this file in your editor, at the section you're reading

secTaskWriteNote.message: save checkboxes back to local files

grantIntro.message: To save a checked task back to its file, Markloupe needs read/write access to the folder. Access is kept inside the extension; ordinary web pages, including local HTML files, cannot reach it.

grantBackNote.message: When you're done, go back to the document and click the checkbox again.

grantTip1.message: Authorize a high-level folder (for example D:\Projects) and every .md under it becomes writable.

grantTip2.message: After Chrome restarts you may be asked to confirm again; choose Allow on every visit in the prompt to avoid this.

grantTip3.message: Only the clicked checkbox line is changed, and nothing is written if the file was changed elsewhere.

welcomeLead.message: Read Markdown right in the browser: outline, folding, sortable tables, Mermaid diagrams — and check off tasks straight into the file.

step1Text.message: To read .md files on your computer, Chrome needs a switch that only you can turn on.

step1Li1.message: Open Markloupe's settings with the button below

step1Li2.message: Turn on Allow access to file URLs

step1Li3.message: Come back here — the status updates by itself

welcomeFileOk.message: ✔ On — local files can be read

step2Text.message: Drag any .md file into a Chrome window, or type its path in the address bar (for example D:\Projects\README.md). To read .md files on websites, turn on the option below.

step2Tip.message: Tip: pin Markloupe to the toolbar (puzzle icon → pin). Its button opens theme, font and layout settings.

featTables.message: Tables: drag column widths, click headers to sort, filter, copy for spreadsheets

featTasks.message: Check off tasks: click - [ ] in a local file to save it (you'll authorize the folder the first time)

featDiagrams.message: Diagrams and math: ```mermaid blocks and $$…$$ formulas are drawn automatically

featReload.message: Live reload: save in your editor and the page updates within a second, keeping scroll position and folds

step4Title.message: Optional: aligned CJK in code blocks

step4Text.message: CJK text and box-drawing tables in code are aligned automatically. For the best result install the free Sarasa Mono TC, then fully restart Chrome (type chrome://restart in the address bar).

toolFontSizeTitle.message: Font size — scales the whole document (+ / − / 0)

colorInvalid.message: Enter a color code such as #1e1e2e

colorLowContrast.message: Low contrast, hard to read (4.5:1 or more is better): $1

optWebAccessNote.message: Chrome will ask to read and change your data on all websites. Markloupe still runs only on addresses that end in .md, .markdown, .mkd or .mdx. Reload tabs that are already open.

optSync.message: Sync settings to my other computers

optSyncNote.message: Uses your browser account. Folder access, reading positions and the editor URL stay on this computer.

customCssTooLarge.message: Custom CSS is over 8 KB; it is saved here but not synced
